value.rationale: The first two Fourier degrees are a natural low-complexity spectral band for Boolean counting convolution of independent dominating sets. The exact all-n exception classification identifies the unique pairwise harmonic obstruction at length nine, and proves recovery of every pairwise frequency for all larger cycles. This is a motivated natural complete classification of pair-character zeros, not a routine finite table; the proof requires an all-distance inequality.
